column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1 and transliterates “a poem” as “A Maskil.” Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “riddles” is rendered “dark sayings.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ancestors” is rendered “fathers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to make them known” is rendered “That they should teach them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the region of Zoan” is rendered “the field of Zoan.”
Close to the Hebrew; “like the great deeps” is rendered “abundant drink like the ocean depths.”
Close to the Hebrew; “food for their soul” is rendered “food according to their desire.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the grain of heaven” is rendered “food from heaven.”
“The bread of the mighty ones” is rendered “the bread of angels,” and “each one ate” as “Man did eat.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB links verses 27–28 with “When … Then.”
“His camp … His dwellings” is rendered “their camp … their dwellings.”
“They had not turned from their desire” is rendered “Before they had satisfied their desire.”
